title: EVA Preparation: Tether and Tool Check

steps.hint: Look to your right for the panel labelled AIRLOCK. The EVA preparation controls are grouped there.
Select the CHECKLIST tab on the EVA PREP display ahead of you. EVA steps are always worked from the checklist.
The orange TETHER HOOK floats on your left. A tether is a safety line that keeps you attached to the vehicle.

steps.instruction: Place the TETHER HOOK on the TETHER ANCHOR.
steps.hint: TETHER ANCHOR is the left socket on the TOOL RACK panel. Check the hook seats fully; only the tether hook fits.
TETHER CHECK is the top-left button on the AIRLOCK panel. It confirms the hook is locked before you go further.
The SUIT PRESSURE dial is top-right on the AIRLOCK panel. Check it points at NOMINAL, the normal operating value.
The PISTOL GRIP floats above the tether hook on your left. Never release a tool until it is secured.

steps.instruction: Place the PISTOL GRIP in the TOOL CADDY.
steps.hint: TOOL CADDY is the right socket on the TOOL RACK panel. Check the tool seats fully; a secured tool cannot drift away.

steps.instruction: Press REPORT to confirm EVA preparation.
steps.hint: REPORT is below TETHER CHECK on the AIRLOCK panel. Leave DEPRESS VALVE alone; depressurising is a later step.
